ud4.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā cālikāyaṃ viharati cālike pabbate.
ud4.1:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā meghiyo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud4.1:1.4: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud4.1:2.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud4.1:2.2: jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkami.
ud4.1:2.3: upasaṅkamitvā kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasā ko ambavanaṃ pāsādikaṃ manuññaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
ud4.1:2.5: “pāsādikaṃ vatidaṃ ambavanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. alaṃ vatidaṃ kulaputtassa padhānatthikassa padhānāya.
ud4.1:2.6: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā”ti.
ud4.1:3.1: atha kho āyasmā meghiyo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud4.1:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud4.1:4.1: “idhāhaṃ bhante pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya jantugāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
ud4.1:4.2: jantugāme piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena kimikālāya nadiyā tīraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
ud4.1:4.3: upasaṅkamitvā kimikālāya nadiyā tīre jaṅghāvihāraṃ anucaṅkamamāno anuvicaramāno addasaṃ ambavanaṃ pāsādikaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.
ud4.1:4.7: sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyāti.
ud4.1:4.8: sace maṃ bhante bhagavā anujānāti, gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā’ti.
ud4.1:5.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ meghiyaṃ etadavoca:
ud4.1:5.2: ‘āgamehi tāva meghiya, ekakamhā yāva aññopi koci bhikkhu āgacchatī”ti.
ud4.1:6.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā meghiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud4.1:6.2: “bhagavato bhante, natthi kiñci uttari karaṇīyaṃ, natthi katassa vā paticayo.
ud4.1:6.3: mayhaṃ kho pana bhante, atthi uttari3 karaṇīyaṃ, atthi katassa paticayo.
ud4.1:6.4: sace maṃ bhante, bhagavā anujānāti gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā”ti.
ud4.1:6.5: dutiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ meghiyaṃ etadavoca:
ud4.1:6.6: “āgamehi tāva meghiya, ekakamhā yāva añño koci4 bhikkhu āgacchatī”ti.

ud4.1:8.2: atha kho āyasmato meghiyassa tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tayo pāpakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti. seyyathidaṃ?

ud4.1:9.4: atha ca panimehi tīhi pāpakehi akusalehi vitakkehi anvāsattā seyyathidaṃ?

ud4.1:10.2: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, tasmiṃ ambavane viharantassa yebhuyyena tayo pāpakā akusalā vitakkā samudācaranti. seyyathidaṃ:
ud4.1:10.6: saddhāya ca vatamhi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito,
ud4.1:10.7: atha ca panimehi tīhi pāpakehi akusalehi vitakkehi anvāsattā. seyyathidaṃ –
ud4.1:11.1: aparipakkāya meghiya, cetovimuttiyā pañca dhammā paripākāya saṃvattanti.
ud4.1:12.1: idha meghiya, bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto hoti kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko.
ud4.1:12.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ paṭhamo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:13.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
ud4.1:13.2: aparipakkāya meghiya, cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ dutiyo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:14.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya, bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. seyyathidaṃ? appicchakathā, santuṭṭhikathā, pavivekakathā, asaṃsaggakathā, vīriyārambhakathā, sīlakathā, samādhikathā, paññākathā, vimuttikathā, vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā. evarūpāya kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī;
ud4.1:14.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ tatiyo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:15.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
ud4.1:15.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ catuttho dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:16.1: puna caparaṃ meghiya, bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
ud4.1:16.2: aparipakkāya meghiya cetovimuttiyā ayaṃ pañcamo dhammo paripākāya saṃvattati.
ud4.1:16.3: aparipakkāya meghiya, cetovimuttiyā ime pañca dhammā paripākāya saṃvattanti.

ud4.1:20.1: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ meghiya, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ1 kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇasampavaṅkassa yaṃ paññavā bhavissati. udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
ud4.1:21.1: tena ca pana meghiya, bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro dhammā uttari bhāvetabbā.
ud4.1:21.2: “asubhā bhāvetabbā rāgassa pahānāya, mettā bhāvetabbā byāpādassa pahānāya, ānāpānassati bhāvetabbā vitakkupacchedāya, aniccasaññā bhāvetabbā asmimānasamugghātāya.
ud4.1:21.4: anattasaññī asmimānasamugghātaṃ pāpuṇāti, diṭṭheva dhamme nibbānaṃ”ti.
ud4.1:22.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
